observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A large public plaza in front of an ornate municipal building on a sunny day.
observation.dancers: Mixed group of performers including men in elaborate devil/archangel costumes and women in golden/colourful tiered skirts.
observation.formation_and_space: Group formations ranging from scattered positions to lines and circles, performing dynamic group travel and coordinated choreography.
observation.posture: Upright torso with engaged core, knees flexing dynamically with weighted steps and leaps.
observation.footwork: Bouncy marching steps, high kicks, skips, and energetic leaps on the beat; fast intricate footwork cannot be clearly verified due to sample rate.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held wide or raised, waving small cloth streamers, capes, or staffs.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains upright with energetic bounces and occasional twists corresponding to jumps and turns.
observation.partnering: None; group choreography without physical contact between dancers.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent high leaps, energetic jumps, and rapid spins.
observation.costume_and_props: Elaborate multi-tiered dresses, devil masks with horns and dragons, feathered capes, winged archangel costumes, and face masks.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact footwork intricacy and fast weight transfers are obscured by camera movement and frame rate.

signature_moments.what: An archangel character in white with large wings performs high kicks and skips with arm extensions.
A masked dancer with elaborate dragon headpiece and golden cape performs rhythmic stepping while waving fabric streamers.
Female dancers in yellow and red tiered skirts skip in unison, swinging fabric ribbons overhead.
